body:
# ChestLock | Simple & Secure Container Protection

**ChestLock** is a lightweight, zero-lag, and highly secure protection plugin for modern Minecraft servers (1.20 - 1.21+)[cite: 1]. Say goodbye to complicated commands and confusing signs! With ChestLock, players can secure their loot using a simple, intuitive **Name Tag** mechanic[cite: 1]. It is built with absolute performance in mind and features extensive anti-griefing protections.

## 🎮 How to Use
Securing your items has never been easier:
1. **To Lock:** Take a Name Tag, rename it to exactly `Lock` in an anvil, and Right-Click the chest or container[cite: 1].
2. **To Unlock:** Rename a Name Tag to `Unlock` and Right-Click your locked block to remove the protection[cite: 1].

## ⭐ Core Features
* **Multi-Block Protection:** Works flawlessly with Chests, Trapped Chests, Barrels, and Shulker Boxes[cite: 1].
* **Item Frame Security:** Protects your Item Frames from being broken, rotated, or washed away[cite: 1]. 
* **Double Chest Smart-Sync:** Locking one side of a double chest automatically secures the other half[cite: 1].
* **Shulker Box Mobility:** When you break your own locked Shulker Box, the lock transfers to the dropped item and automatically re-applies when placed again[cite: 1]!
* **Bedrock Compatible:** Fully integrates with Geyser and the Floodgate API, ensuring Bedrock players can lock their chests securely with proper UUID resolution[cite: 1].

## 🛡️ Anti-Grief & Exploit Proof
Built with maximum security, ChestLock stops griefers in their tracks with 18 built-in exploit fixes:
* **Explosion Proof:** Protected blocks cannot be destroyed by TNT, Creepers, or Withers[cite: 1].
* **Anti-Hopper Theft:** Blocks unauthorized Hoppers and Hopper Minecarts from draining your items[cite: 1].
* **Piston & Liquid Protection:** Prevents pistons from moving locked blocks, and stops water/lava from destroying Item Frames[cite: 1].
* **Spectator Bypass Blocked:** Prevents players in spectator mode from peeking into locked containers[cite: 1].

## 🛠️ Admin Tools & Commands
* `/clinfo` - Look at any block to see exactly who owns the lock and when it was secured[cite: 1].
* `/unlockall <player>` - Instantly remove all locks belonging to a specific player (Perfect for server resets or bans)[cite: 1].
* `/clreload` - Reloads the plugin configuration and messages without restarting the server[cite: 1].
* **Database Backed:** Uses PDC (Persistent Data Container) for real-time checks, fully backed by async SQLite/MySQL database storage to ensure data is never lost[cite: 1]
